SHOPPER — six screens with no design of record.

Every one is backed by a route that already exists and has no client:

· Request a return → POST /me/orders/:id/return
· My returns → GET /me/returns
· Write a review → POST /me/reviews
· Rate what you bought → GET /me/reviews/pending
· Delivery addresses → /me/addresses (+ set default)
· Saved → GET /me/wishlist

The two that matter most: nothing in the system can create a review today, so every rating on the marketplace is null and the product screen's review list is permanently empty. And the seller's returns queue can only read empty until a buyer can start one.

Address book carries GhanaPostGPS, a column the seller's order screen already renders and nobody writes.

SELLER — five screens that are already BUILT and shipped without a design.

These are the design of record after the fact, drawn from what the code does, so the canvas and the app agree. Change anything here and it is a change request, not a new build.

· Returns queue and decision — PR #82
· Restock sheet — the one Ejua Sell canvas element that was drawn and never built, now built
· Edit a listing — screen 08 in reverse
· Shop setup — PR #81

One known lie to settle: the queue ships copy for a 'withdrawn' return and nothing in the system can set that status. Either the buyer gets a withdraw control on 'My returns' (page 1) or the copy goes.
